title: Hate
extract:
Hate is a deadly scythe wielded by the Stalker.
This weapon can be sold for  5,000.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage. 
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Reaping Spiral and  Shadow Harvest (Conclave only) stance.
Can use the Hate-exclusive  Burning Hate mod.
Incarnon neutral attack has innate heat damage that enables this.
The innate heat does combine with any non-combinational elements modded onto Hate.
 Reaping Spiral neutral attack with the Incarnon mode activated will trigger  Lifted that activates  Melee Afflictions and  Burning Hate if  Heat damage is already applied.

Advantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Second highest base damage of all scythes, behind  Caustacyst.
Second highest critical chance of all scythes, behind  Reaper Prime.
Tied with Reaper Prime for the highest critical multiplier of all scythes.

Acquisition
The Hate's blueprint is dropped by the (Shadow) Stalker. It is also included in the What Stalker? bundle for  725 in the market.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

Notes

Upon completion of The Duviri Paradox and Angels of the Zariman, and unlocking The Steel Path, players can earn  Hate Incarnon Genesis from The Circuit's Steel Path to place on their Hate with the help of Cavalero in the Chrysalith. This Incarnon Genesis form grants it evolutions to a transformation and newfound strength.
Purchased from Cavalero for  120, complete with the resources used in its installation. This purchase can only be made once.

Installing the Hate Incarnon Genesis requires 20  Pathos Clamp, 70  Dracroot and 20  Maw Fang.
When installed, the first Evolution tier is unlocked. Each challenge additionally grants 5,000 affinity to the weapon, affected by Affinity Boosters.

Overview
Incarnon Form is charged by building Melee Combo to 6x, then using a Heavy Attack. Once activated, the Incarnon form lasts for 180 seconds.
Incarnon Form persists through all activities, such as holstering, bleedout, or being disarmed. However, Incarnon Form is removed upon death.

Evolutions

Trivia
When holding a datamass, your character will swing Hate with one hand.
Despite the Hate being the weapon featured in the  Stalking Fan card, the Hate's stance polarity matches  Reaping Spiral's instead.
